The short version

A rich sherry-cask rye with substantial support for body, development and persistence, alongside a sharply less favorable dusty/chemical-like account. The release predates its 2026 reviews.

Exact identity: Lot No. 40 Rye Explorations Release No. 04 Oloroso Casks, 2025-era NAS release, 53.4% ABV / 106.8 proof, 750 mL.

Background and history

The producer’s September 2025 catalogue record and 2025 Ontario release material place it before the 2026 independent accounts. A later tasting date is not a first-release date.

This fourth numbered exploration is distinct from Port Casks and Cherry Wood. Awards and numbered-release status are not sensory evidence.

Critical review synthesis

Patrick and Martin · Québec Whisky

Both find broad fruit/spice development, ample oily texture and a long ending, with the rye character surviving the sherry influence.

Scope: July 15, 2026 exact 53.4%, translated French; awards discussion excluded from Quality.

Kim · Québec Whisky

Kim instead reports dusty, waxed-furniture and minty impressions with deficient balance and an unsatisfying dusty ending. A second pass improves enjoyment without removing the reservation.

Scope: Same July 15, 2026 page; three individual accounts from one publication, not three independent publishers.

Published sample evidence, not first-person tasting or a representative survey. Reviewer disagreement and recipe-era limitations remain explicit; publisher grades are not mechanically converted.

Quality and calibration

Quality 7.2 / 10. Very good provisional Canadian all-rye execution. Rich texture and developed fruit/spice with a persistent ending have substantive support; dusty, furniture-polish-like and imbalanced impressions from a separate reviewer reduce certainty and cleanliness/integration judgments.

No defensible complete Canadian native 1/5/10 framework is established for this comparison group. Seven universal execution dimensions are assessed within Canadian Single Grain / 100% Rye; unrelated American bourbon and straight-rye endpoints are not imported.

Calibration mode: evidence_limited_provisional. Evidence-limited provisional; matched independent tasting with sample and era limitations

Serving recommendations

Neat

Try a small full-strength pour and allow time in the glass; the matched accounts disagree on some finish and cask effects.

Water / rocks

Add only a few drops at a time and compare texture. Several reviewers find too much dilution reduces definition.

Old Fashioned

Keep syrup restrained; a recurring core rye is the price comparison before mixing a limited bottle.

Manhattan / highball

Try a small serve with vermouth or soda, adjusting sweetness and dilution to the cask influence.

Serving suggestions are editorial starting points, grounded in documented strength and style; adjust to your taste.
